title: A torsion-intersection proof of perfect-cuboid nonexistence on 1,072 explicit master-tuple fibers
summary: Building on the genus-3 reduction $C_A : w^2 = λ^8 + A λ^4 + 1$ established in our companion paper (arXiv:2604.09328), we give an unconditional proof of the perfect-cuboid conjecture ("Conjecture B") on $1{,}072$ explicit master-tuple fibers, excluding all rational $(a,b)$-specialisations on each such fiber.
